goal: Prevent initial headers sync from stalling indefinitely when syncing against inbound or manual peers
Allow another connected peer to take over headers sync when the active peer returns an empty headers response
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, hodlinator)
Resolved objection: delayed empty response could immediately retake the slot without timeout (jeanpablojp)
Resolved objection: connecting headers could bypass backoff, deferred to follow-up (danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an indefinite initial headers sync stall during initial block download
Inbound and manual peers currently retain the sync slot on empty replies without being evicted or timed out
Fix ensures syncing nodes can switch to other peers that have the latest chain
